limitations: All 42 patients selected the classifier and have been inspected; not fresh end-to-end validation.
LAC and no-CP modes are diagnostic sensitivity/ablation, not replacement deployments.
All methods share mandatory guards and severity-based recapture costs; not pure literature baselines.
Allocation review price is tuned; outcome scoring always uses the same fixed evaluation ledger.
No pooled outcome is generated unless every excluded fold has real actions.
Equal-cost LP optima may depend on solver version or row ordering; both are recorded.
Paired intervals condition on fitted overlapping-fold policies and fixed actions, with no refitting/reallocation.
Intervals are descriptive, unadjusted for multiple comparisons and do not certify resampled cohort capacities.
Matching budget caps is not matching realized workloads; no clinical safety or prospective benefit is established.

mode_interpretation.ordinal: Current deployed conformal guard; research policy comparisons only.
mode_interpretation.lac: Conventional LAC sensitivity analysis; no deployment replacement.
mode_interpretation.no_cp: No-conformal diagnostic ablation; no deployment replacement.

status_interpretation.evaluated: All excluded folds have real actions; pooled outcomes are available.
status_interpretation.incomplete: One or more folds is untunable or overloaded; pooled outcomes are null.
status_interpretation.untunable: No tuning candidate is feasible on the 112-image tuning cohort; no excluded-fold outcome.
status_interpretation.overloaded: Allocation exceeds mandatory capacities in an excluded evaluation fold; no actions.
